Payment change and carrier impersonation scenarios will be part of the annual course, with a one-page call-back procedure kept at the desk (POL-01 6.3).

implementation_statement: Passwords are long but some are reused (the personal email that recovers the FMCSA account shares a password with the load board). No password manager. Gap closes with a password manager and unique passphrases by 2026-09-30.
The ransomware runbook (P08) with a contact list was adopted on 2026-09-08. Gap: contacts not printed and the runbook not walked through (due 2026-10-31).
Paper is cross-cut shredded at the home office. Gap: no written way to wipe an old laptop or phone before disposal or trade-in, and no record of disposals.
First risk assessment completed 2026-08-14 using SP 800-30 Rev. 1 (P01). Reviewed each August and after a major change.

The owner relies on 9 outside services (P04). Only the TMS vendor's assurance (SOC 2 report) has been reviewed. No vendor list; breach notice terms not checked against the 10-day third-party agent duty in Fla. Stat. 501.171(6).

The laptop's built-in host firewall is on. Gap: the home network is shared with household devices. The owner moves business devices to their own network (router guest or separate network) by 2026-12-31.
All SaaS services, the bank, the railroad portals, and the FMCSA site use TLS (inherited). Carrier packets are no longer sent by open link (AC-3).
evidence: Browser certificate checks; vendor SOC 2 report

The operating system's built-in antivirus runs real-time scanning with automatic updates. Owner responsibility: keep it on and act on alerts.

Transaction records must be kept 3 years (49 CFR 371.3(b)); today they live only in the TMS and nothing is ever deleted. POL-01 8.7 sets a schedule: transaction records 3 years after the load, carrier packets 3 years after the carrier's last load, then disposal. First export and purge by 2026-12-31.

Author mapping: carriers are the brokerage's suppliers. The monitoring service checks each carrier's authority and insurance and alerts on changes. Gap: no identity check that the email domain and phone match the carrier's registered contact; no call-back before changing a carrier's bank details.
